newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil - tone strengthens after Monday knock.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil - tone strengthens after Monday knock.

text.p: High sulphur cracked fuel barges on Tuesday regained ground lost on Monday with trades done at $109, $109.50 and $110 fob ARA.
On Monday barges were heard as low as $107, but firmer swaps prices and a feeling that yesterday's drop had been overdone. Arms-length support also came from stronger crude.
High sulphur cargoes were seen steady around $108-109 fob NWE amid quiet talk. Traders said negotiations were underway by the winners of the Portuguese tender to secure product.
Unconfirmed talk was of a trader picking up two cargoes plus two options and a major picking up two cargoes.

Low sulphur cracked was slower the issue of a Turkish buy tender yesterday for 45-50,000 tonnes into Izmir an Izmit during October. Bids have to be in by September 25 and the award will be on September 27. Prices were seen to be a touch firmer around $120 fob NWE. The 50:50 deal done at $125.75 cif Milazzo was seen as very good for the buyer.

Low sulphur straight run was static. Supplies were thin matched by disinterested buyers. "We are waiting for a trend and for October buying," said one trader. Prices were a touch above yesterday's $125 fob NWE.
